semiconductor_relevance: High — Fujikin (Deutschland) GmbH provides critical flow control components and gas handling solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Fujikin (Deutschland) GmbH specializes in advanced flow technology, offering a range of flow control components such as valves, meters, gauges, regulators, and mass flow controllers. The company also provides gas handling solutions including cabinets, control systems, and supply systems, which are vital for maintaining precise environmental conditions in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Flow control components: valves, meters, gauges, regulators, MFCs
Gas handling solutions: cabinets, control systems, supply systems
